step1_analysis.description: An RF variable gain amplifier that uses a current-controlled bias network to adjust the transconductance of a common-source amplifier with a cascode output stage.

paper_reference.title: A Variable Gain Amplifier With 50-dB Control Range for 900-MHz Applications

voltage_gain.description: Maximum AC voltage gain at the operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm3 * R3. With I_ctrl=1mA, gm3 ~ 16mS, R3=500 ohm -> Gain ~ 8 V/V = 18 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adapted to 1.8V CMOS, the gain will be slightly lower than the 2.8V BiCMOS original due to lower supply headroom and gm/Id efficiency.

gain_control_range.description: The range over which the gain can be adjusted by varying the control current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Difference between max gain (I_ctrl=1mA) and min gain (I_ctrl=10uA).
sky130_expected.reasoning: CMOS square-law provides less transconductance variation over the same current range compared to BJT exponential law, reducing the control range.

operating_frequency.description: The target frequency for the RF amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Set by the testbench AC source.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The circuit is broadband enough to operate at 900 MHz in SKY130.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the amplifier.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down for 1.8V CMOS operation and smaller device sizes in the testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain at 900 MHz, bandwidth, and transient output swing of the VGA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VGA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param I_ctrl = 1m

* DUT (NPNs replaced with SKY130 NMOS)
I1 VDD RFi {I_ctrl}
R3 RFo N4 500
R2 VDD N0 500
R1 N5 GND 600
M5 RFo Vbias N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50u l=0.15u
M2 N0 RFi N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10u l=0.15u
M1 RFi RFi N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10u l=0.15u
M3 N1 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50u l=0.15u
C1 N4 GND 10p
C2 N0 GND 10p

* Fix floating N4 (AC ground in original, needs DC path)
V_N4 N4 0 1.8

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS Vbias 0 1.2

* AC Input
Cin RFin RFi 10p
Vac RFin 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 10m 900Meg)

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8 - i(V_N4) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 50 10Meg 10Gig
  let gain_db = vdb(RFo)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(RFo))
  meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
  meas ac gain_900mhz find gain_db at=900Meg
  meas ac phase_900mhz find phase at=900Meg
  meas ac bw_0db when gain_db=0 fall=1

  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran vout_max max v(RFo) from=2n to=5n
  meas tran vout_min min v(RFo) from=2n to=5n
  let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
  print vout_pp
.endc
.end
